title: Postmortem
author: Patricia Cornwell
summary: Dr Kay Scarpetta, Richmond's chief medical examiner, is racing against a killer who strikes women in their homes, while also dealing with politics and sexism in her own department.
readIf: you like forensic detail and a smart, determined investigator who works from the evidence.
skipIf: you dislike clinical descriptions of autopsies and crime scenes.

pairings.reason: Another landmark of the serial-killer thriller from the same era, with a female investigator.
A forensic-led chase with a brilliant investigator and a killer who plays games.
A patient, procedural series opener that rewards close attention to evidence.
